name: wanted-level
description: Crimson Rogue stars for risky moves: force pushes, rm -rf, hard resets, secrets, the paid Jev endpoint, and project deletes. Stars fade with time; at five stars the next risky call is blocked until they fade or you run /lay-low.

fadeMinutes.title: Fade minutes
fadeMinutes.description: Minutes with no risky move before one star fades.
